source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Relationship; printed p.16, PDF p.31
original_meaning: Describes physical relationships to a parent and/or child components. Relationship has an optional parent Relation Link and a required child list permitting zero or more entries. Each Relation Link requires a UCI and a Link value; the sealed Link enumeration is ATTACHED or DETACHED.
mapping_boundary: This is physical attachment information, not merely logical CIC membership, network connectivity or permission. The required child list may be empty; do not infer an actual parent or child, complete parts inventory, installed attachment, coordinate, offset or transform from the type definition.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Visible; printed p.17, PDF p.32
original_meaning: The Boolean property is set to true when the laser is in the visible spectrum.
mapping_boundary: Not architectural visible/opaque membership, discovery visibility, line of sight, display visibility, active laser emission or a measured detection. The definition supplies no numeric wavelength boundary or actual value for any case.
